decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The development would be in keeping with the character and appearance of the building and will not adversely affect the amenities of neighbouring residential properties, or the setting of the neighbouring listed building.  The balcony feature is of limited projection and would not be of sufficient size to form a sitting out area.  The development would preserve the character of Old Chiswick Conservation Area.  It would comply with policies ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B.2.2, ENV-B.2.5 and H.6.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan
description: Erection of bay and canopy to first floor rear window, erection of a new detached conservatory in rear garden, installation of a gate and formation of underground water tank to side of house.
